reviews.text: They've been bathing my two dogs at our house for several years now and have always done a very good job despite my 60 pound bully-mix not being cooperative. Andres and Arturo have always done a thorough job and give nice reviews of how the dogs did after. Both dogs always looked and smelled great and were happy with the bathing (being over) as well.

Superb groomers!  Coming to you, these groomer have a perfect eye for the best cuts to remove mats without making your dog look ridiculously shaved. Gentle and wonderfully competent. Will definitely use them again!🐾💕🐾💕
